commands.command:
date -u
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
for k in db/sysman/off_sensing_result db/sysman/el_sensing_result db/sysman/off_sensing_time db/sysman/el_sensing_time db/sysman/off_sensing_count; do
 echo "VCONF_KEY $k"
 vconftool get "$k"
 key_status=$?
 echo "VCONF_GET_EXIT $key_status"
done
cat /proc/uptime
date -u
